patches.reason: HostFS, networking, mousehack and Portable host-idle shortcuts are removed; ordinary guest SWI exception only.
Remove desktop loaders and tables; fresh typed empty-drive edge, complete reset, no stale DMA after synchronous refusal, invalid-command response, bounded result indices and FIFO parameter quotas.
